properties.name: registry
properties.purpose:
The graph registry: a process-level map from graph_id to an open design, owning the per-graph metadata that today rides on ReflowService as per-process state — graph_path, content_path, identity, and the write_gen counter the loop nudge reads (service.rs:94-99).

New module, does not exist today. What binds the process to one graph is the CLI contract and the startup path in main.rs, not the core: DesignGraph::open_rocksdb (graph.rs:113) is already a plain function call with no process-global state, and ReflowService.graph is already Arc<RwLock<DesignGraph>> (service.rs:74) because several sessions already share one server. So this component is a map of things already shaped to be shared, plus a lifecycle — on-demand bounded opening, single-flight so concurrent first requests for one graph collapse into one open, an idle timeout per graph, and a cap on simultaneously open graphs with a stated error at the cap.

Holds N single-writer stores with one RocksDB lock each. It does not make any store multi-writer.
